title: Greer says the octagon craft is made by Lockheed Skunk Works
summary: UAPGerb tells of Greer says the octagon craft is made by Lockheed Skunk Works, about present at North Brumit (as said), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I mean, it's been talked about publicly by Greer, but he always says that he knows the craft you saw, the souped up version of the agon retrieved is made by the Lockheit skull works in North Brumit.

plain: On a 2025 episode of Jesse Michels's podcast with Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, an online UFO commentator called UAPGerb passes on a claim from the disclosure activist Steven Greer. According to UAPGerb, Greer says he knows the craft Herrera saw, a souped-up version of an octagon-shaped craft that was recovered, and that it is made by Skunk Works, the secret advanced-aircraft division of the company Lockheed, at a place given as "North Brumit." If true, the craft would be human-made rather than alien.
